svg.text: HAXĀ — SECTION A–A THROUGH THE CROWN AXIS
Original Rhino model re-engineered around a Sellita SW300-1 (standard fitting, no seconds). Case, bezel, stud and bracelet surfaces unchanged; crown shape unchanged, moved 0.168 mm down.
dial art top under hour hand
Case middle — source exterior; bore, bezel counterbore, caseback thread, crown-tube hole cut
Bezel — source exterior + lip; crystal pocket Ø33.20 cut from below
Sapphire crystal Ø33.00 × 1.20, fitted from inside
60 pillars — source, applied to dial (feet to detail)
Dial — source plate 0.41; Ø2.06 centre hole; 2 feet Ø0.75
Dial art — source figure, wings, stones, logo
Hands — source blades; collets on Sellita Ø1.50 / Ø0.90
Crown — source; tube Ø2.50; stem S0.90 on Sellita axis
MEASURED CHECKS (computed on the model meshes)
Hour hand → highest dial art under its sweep
Hour hand top → minute hand underside
Rotor security, nominal / worst (+0.10 mvt height)
Case wall at bore / thread / counterbore (sampled min)
Exterior: source case / bezel vertices off the rebuilt surface
Unexpected interference (triangle overlap, all part pairs)
Sampled values are bracket ends over the stated grids, not guaranteed minima. Bracelet end links sit up to 0.29 mm inside the case in the original source: not covered by this sheet.
